facts.business: Tata Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells basic chemistry products (primarily Soda Ash, Salt, and Sodium Bicarbonate) and specialty products across a global footprint spanning North America, Europe, Africa, and Asia.
key_risks: Revenue overstatement risk in specialty chemical business due to pressure to achieve performance targets
Litigations and claims relating to direct and indirect tax matters across various states in India
Global Soda Ash market oversupply and pricing pressure from higher imports and Chinese export redirection
Foreign currency exposure from international operations and loan repayments (GBP denominated)
